labels.zh-CN: 按目标完赛的所需配速
按终点关门的最慢配速

details.formulaDescription: Parse start, target and finish cutoff as minutes since midnight. Require start < target <= finishCutoff, otherwise an order error. requiredPaceSecondsPerKm = round((target - start) * 60 / distanceKm). cutoffPaceSecondsPerKm = round((finishCutoff - start) * 60 / distanceKm). For each checkpoint, predicted = start + km * requiredPaceRaw / 60 and buffer = cutoff - predicted. The tightest checkpoint is the one with the smallest raw buffer; tightestBufferMinutes is that buffer rounded to the nearest minute. finishBufferMinutes = finishCutoff - target. Verdict: any checkpoint buffer below 0 is infeasible; otherwise the smallest raw buffer below 15 minutes is at-risk; otherwise feasible. An empty checkpoint list is allowed and the verdict then follows the finish buffer only.
assumptions: Pace is assumed even and constant from start to finish; the tool does not model climbs, heat, waits or negative splits.
All clock times are on the same day; the tool does not handle after-midnight cutoffs.
Checkpoint cutoffs are deadlines to leave the station, as stated by trail race regulations; road races may apply them as passage times.
The target finish is a planned goal, not a predicted performance; predicted arrivals are projections at the constant required pace.
The 15-minute at-risk threshold is a planning heuristic, not an official race rule.
details.rounding: Paces round to the nearest whole second per kilometre; buffers and finish buffer round to the nearest whole minute; verdict thresholds are compared on unrounded raw buffers before rounding.
